name: mech-91-power-switches-recipe-room
source: mech-91-power-switches-recipe Test Level: recipe of one floor switch (F), one weight switch (W) and one toggle (T) wired to one elevator gate (E) with a 0/3 to 3/3 HUD counter; two push blocks (B) start below the plates so either plate can be held by a block; standing on the floor switch reaches 3/3 only while stood there and stepping off toward the gate drops the counter to 2/3, while leaving blocks on both plates plus the toggle holds 3/3 and calls the elevator to the orb and warp beyond

F.label: floor switch (held by player or block)

W.label: weight switch (held only by a block)
